name: Top App Bar
structurePatterns: horizontal row: optional leading back/close action | title (grows, single-line ellipsis) | trailing icon actions
no shadow by default; on scroll a 1px subtle divider appears (not elevation)
at most 2 visible trailing icon actions before overflow
safe area is owned by the platform layer
usageHints: large page titles belong in content, not an ever-growing app bar
title truncates with ellipsis rather than wrapping
interactionContract: leading destination/back action and trailing actions are independent hit targets
title layout uses the available safe navigation region supplied by the Platform Adapter
trailing actions overflow or reduce before entering a platform reserved region
keyboardContract: all operable leading/trailing actions remain keyboard reachable when the input context supports keyboard
focus-visible treatment follows T012 input policy and does not depend on hover
accessibilityContract: title remains exposed as the page-level navigation heading/label without being duplicated into host chrome
host/system chrome is not represented as Top App Bar anatomy

platformPresentationRefs.note: Safe Area, reserved regions and host chrome are resolved outside Core.
WeChat Capsule remains host-owned chrome and only constrains the available safe navigation region.
